Founded on Islay’s south coast in 1816, Lagavulin is one of the island’s historic distilleries. Distilled in 2007, this 2023 Distillers Edition is a single malt Scotch given a second maturation in casks seasoned with Pedro Ximénez sherry, a defining production feature of Lagavulin’s Distillers Edition series.
